scope: Repair silent G6 audit and G6-to-G7 handoff input collisions

repair.change: G6 audit and handoff indexing now rejects duplicate plan/response/oracle IDs, duplicate arm records, missing oracle rows, and unexpected response IDs instead of silently replacing or ignoring records.

reproduction.before: Dictionary comprehensions in the audit/handoff paths could replace duplicate rows; missing/extra combinations were not uniformly rejected before downstream processing.
reproduction.after: Collision and bijection guards fail closed, preserve the first indexed row for diagnostics, and prevent handoff output creation on invalid inputs.
